purpose: Cleaning and separating rice grain from chaff, dust, and lighter impurities using a controlled air blast and an oscillating sieve.

power_transmission.description: The motor drives the main shaft through the B65 V-belt.

sieve_types.description: Three interchangeable perforated nets — large, medium, and small hole sizes for different crops.

core_mechanism.summary: The motor drives a main shaft via the V-belt. This main shaft operates the blower unit and uses a sieve cam/linkage to shake the sieve.
core_mechanism.main_shaft: Driven by the motor through the B65 V-belt; sieve shaft uses 6203×2 bearings; blower uses UCP206×2 pillow blocks and 6302×8 ball bearings.

blower_unit.function: Generates the air blast that separates light chaff and dust from heavier grain.

sieve_mechanism.function: The main shaft's cam and linkage shake the sieve back and forth to grade and separate the grain.

materials.main_frame: Plain Carbon Steel angle bars (38 x 38 x 3 mm)

common_issues: V-belt (B65) slipping, cracking, or over/under tension causing low shaft speed.
Worn or noisy UCP206 / 6302 / 6203 bearings causing vibration and heat.
Blower imbalance or blade damage reducing air blast and cleaning quality.
Sieve cam/linkage wear or loose fasteners causing weak or uneven oscillation.
Motor not starting or running slow (voltage, capacitor, or winding issues on the 1.5 HP / 1.1 kW, 1400 rpm motor).
Frame or hopper corrosion / cracked welds on the carbon steel angle bars.
Too much air/wind causing good grain to blow away with chaff — adjust air control lever and feed gate.

v_belt_b65.note_bn: বেল্ট (B65) পাওয়া যাবে নিম্নোল্লিখিত ডিলার/দোকান থেকে। অন্য ঠিকানা বানিয়ে বলবেন না — শুধু এই তালিকা দিন।
